## Attachments (Phase 2b): image or PDF to help fill a request

Files are stored on the server disk in the PoC (`UPLOAD_DIR`, the Docker volume), never in
SQLite blobs and never sent to ReqRes. Limits: **5 MB per file** (`MAX_UPLOAD_MB`), at most 3
files per message, types `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/heic`, `image/heif`,
`application/pdf`. The server checks the real file signature (not the extension or the
client's content type), stores it under a random name, and keeps the user's file name only for
display (sanitised).

| Method and path | Body | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/attachments` | `multipart/form-data`, field `file` | `201 {"attachment": AttachmentInfo}` (staged: not yet part of a message) |
| `POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/messages` | `{"content": "...", "attachment_ids": [12, 13]}` (`content` may be empty when there are attachments; `attachment_ids` optional, max 3, must be the caller's staged uploads of this conversation) | `TurnResponse` as before |
| `GET /api/attachments/{id}` | - | the file (`Content-Type` from the validated type, `Content-Disposition: inline; filename="..."`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`) |

Upload errors: `413` over 5 MB, `415` unsupported or mismatching type, `422` too many/none,
`404` unknown conversation, `403` wrong role. Download access: the owning employee, and (once the
attachment is linked to a submitted request) the approver role that reviews that request type
(HR for leave, Finance for claims). Everyone else gets `404`.

```jsonc
AttachmentInfo = { "id": 12, "filename": "clinic-note.pdf", "content_type": "application/pdf",
                   "size_bytes": 183204, "url": "/api/attachments/12", "created_at": "..." }
Message.attachments = [AttachmentInfo]            // on user messages (empty list otherwise)
ConfirmationCard.fields[i].source = "document" | null   // value was read from an attachment
ConfirmationCard.attachments = [AttachmentInfo]   // the documents that will be linked to the request
```

Behaviour:
1. The assistant reads the attachment(s) with the LLM (structured output) and works out whether
   the user wants a **leave** (sick note -> sick leave with the rest dates) or a **claim**
   (receipt -> total, receipt date, merchant/claim type), together with any text the user typed.
2. Whatever is missing or unreadable (e.g. "I could not read the receipt date") is asked for in
   normal text follow-ups; the usual validation, the confirmation card and the explicit Confirm
   still apply. Values read from documents are tagged `source: "document"` on the card.
3. If the document does not match what was typed (dates, amount, a different person's name), the
   card carries a warning; nothing is auto-corrected silently.
4. On Confirm the attachments are linked to the created request (`attachments.request_type`,
   `request_id`) so approvers can open them. Cancelling a request keeps its attachments.
5. Text inside a document is data: it can never trigger approval or change rules.

Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF, PDF; **5 MB per file, 3 per message**. The client checks this first with plain messages (for example "clinic-note.pdf is 7.2 MB; the limit is 5 MB.", "notes.txt is not a supported file type...", "You can attach up to 3 files to one message."); the server re-validates. HEIC often has no browser MIME type, so the extension is used only when the browser gives none, and the upload is re-typed to match. - **Staging:** each valid file appears as a removable chip above the input (image thumbnail from an object URL that is revoked when the chip goes away, or a PDF icon; name, size, spinner while uploading, Retry and Remove on error). Files upload immediately with `POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/attachments` (multipart field `file`, cookie and `X-Requested-With` via `useApi`; no `Content-Type` is set by hand; the conversation is created first when needed). Upload errors 413/415/422/404/5xx are mapped to friendly text (server text is never echoed). - **Sending:** `POST /messages` with `{content, attachment_ids}`; the text may be empty when a file is ready. Send is disabled while an upload is running or failed (retry or remove it, so no file is dropped silently). If the send fails, the text and the chips come back. - **Message length** is counted on the trimmed text (the backend does the same); the counter shows it. - **Thread:** user bubbles show image thumbnails (click for a preview dialog: `role="dialog"`, Escape closes, focus returns to the thumbnail) and PDF chips (open in a new tab). Files are loaded with `fetch` + credentials into a Blob and an object URL (`useAttachmentBlobs`, one download shared by every thumbnail of the same file, revoked when the last one unmounts), never with a plain ``. Phase 2b (attachments) is built. Lint, typecheck, test and build all pass, and I exercised the whole attach flow in the browser pane against the stub. I did not mark the phase complete and made no commit or push.

Model: Sonnet 5 (`claude-sonnet-5`).

## Commands and results
Run in `frontend/`:
- `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck`: no errors.
- `bun run test`: 4 files, 70 tests passed. The 46 existing tests still pass, plus 24 new: 23 in `tests/attachments.test.ts` and 1 more in `tests/chat.test.ts` for the trimmed-length rule.
- `bun run build`: complete.

I ran the built app on 127.0.0.1:9190 against the stub on 127.0.0.1:9191. Both are stopped and 9190/9191 are free; the Docker ports 9180/9181 are untouched.

## Changed files (all under `frontend/`)
- **New, logic:** `app/utils/attachments.ts`, `app/composables/useAttachmentBlobs.ts`, `tests/attachments.test.ts`.
- **New, components:** `StagedFileChip`, `AttachmentItem`, `AttachmentPreview` (all in `app/components/`).
- **Edited:**

The native file dialog can't be driven, so I fed files into the same handlers by script: setting the file input's files and firing `change`, dispatching drag events on the form, and dispatching a paste event on the textarea.

## Deviations and decisions
- **Send blocked on failed uploads:** Send is disabled while any chip is uploading or has failed, so a file is never dropped silently.
- **Progress:** I show an indeterminate spinner rather than a progress bar, because `useApi` goes through `$fetch`, which has no upload progress. This keeps 401 handling and CSRF in one place.
- **Server text not echoed:** upload errors are mapped from the HTTP status only, never from the server `detail`.
- **Optional fields:** `Message.attachments`, `ConfirmationCard.attachments` and `fields[].source` are typed as optional, so older payloads without them still work.
- **Message length:** the counter and the send check now use the trimmed length, as the coordinator specified. This also fixed the composer counter, which previously counted the raw text.
- **Second fix:** the textarea sometimes came up tall when first painted in a hidden or narrow pane, so `ChatComposer` now re-measures on width change.
- **Blob URL sharing:** the same file in a bubble and in a card downloads once and shares one blob URL, revoked when the last thumbnail unmounts.
- **HEIC:** it uses the extension only when the browser gives no type, and the upload is re-typed to match. Browsers that can't render a HEIC show a download chip instead of a thumbnail.

## Asks for the backend
- **Download from a different origin:** `GET /api/attachments/{id}` needs the same CORS handling as the other API routes (explicit origin, credentials true), since the web app fetches it cross-origin.
- **Multipart limit and 413:** please return 413 (not a dropped connection) for oversize bodies, and check the real file signature so a mismatched type gives 415.
- **Attachment-only conversation title:** the stub falls back to "Attachment: <name>" when the first message has no text. Decide what the backend should use.
- **Attachments on user messages:** please return `attachments` on user messages in `GET /conversations/{id}` as well as in `TurnResponse`, so old chats show their thumbnails.
